column2: Open AR invoices are OPEN (uncollected) balances at go-live cutover date only. Do NOT include collected invoices. Validate with: python workday_financial_validator.py open_ar_invoices this_file.csv 3
Customer_ID: Must exactly match a Customer_ID from the Customer Master load
Revenue_Category: Must match a valid Workday Revenue Category Reference ID in your tenant
Invoice_Amount: Open (outstanding) amount at cutover. Enter the amount still owed, not the original invoice amount if partial payments exist
Reconciliation check: Sum of Invoice_Amount must equal Open AR balance on legacy trial balance (by currency)
Load order: Object 6 — load AFTER Customer Master and Revenue Category configuration
